title: Exercise
description: A single practice exercise (flashcard) for the multiple choice app.

inputMode.description: Determines the input UI and validation logic.

mobileSolvable.description: Whether the exercise can be completed comfortably on a small screen without external tools such as a calculator.

learningLevel.description: Learner-facing curriculum stage used as an inclusive maximum filter. This is separate from card difficulty and learner mastery.

difficulty.description: Estimated intrinsic card difficulty used for XP weighting. May later be calibrated from answer data.

instruction.description: Question text shown above the answer area. Supports Markdown.

images.description: Filenames of images in /data/img/ to display alongside the instruction.

answerOptions.description: List of answer options for SINGLE_CHOICE, MULTIPLE_CHOICE, and MATCH modes. Supports Markdown.

submitButton.description: Whether SINGLE_CHOICE requires an explicit submit action. Defaults to true.

correct.description: Non-empty array of correct answers. Item type and cardinality depend on inputMode.

caseSensitive.description: TEXT mode only. Whether the comparison is case-sensitive.

maximumStringDistance.description: TEXT mode only. Maximum Levenshtein distance allowed per word for literal answers. Defaults to 1.

explainInstruction.description: Explanation text shown after answering. Explains the correct answer in context. Supports Markdown.

matchOptions.description: Plain-text right-side labels for MATCH mode. Each entry pairs with an answerOptions item through the indices in correct.

explainAnswerOptions.description: Per-option explanations, one per entry in answerOptions. Shown after answering to explain why each option is correct or incorrect. Supports Markdown.

adminComment.description: Internal note for exercise authors. Not displayed to users.

categories.description: One or more categories for filtering and statistics. Every exercise must have at least one category.

specializations.description: One or more IT specializations for which the exercise is relevant. Every applicable specialization must be listed explicitly. Multiple entries allow overlapping scope, such as FISI and FIDV.

adminTags.description: Optional workflow markers for authors and reviewers, such as draft, needs-review, or error-reported. Not used as learner-facing categories.

correct.description: Permutation array: correct[i] is the index into matchOptions that pairs with answerOptions[i].
